change.description: Allow same-identity Product Release recovery when GitHub leaves a failed run summary in progress after every job has reached a terminal failure state.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is an internal release recovery guard. It does not change application routes, media behavior, persisted application state, or product artifact contents.

current.reasoning: Manual recovery may rebind only an unfrozen release whose ledger failure matches the original run and whose jobs are all terminal with at least one failure; normal retries and frozen-artifact protections remain unchanged.

evidence.command: The recovery predicate requires matching failure provenance and terminal job evidence.

scope_drift.description: The change is limited to Product Release completion recovery and its focused regression test.

verified.reasoning: Focused completion, recovery, failure, ledger, Biome, and unit checks pass. The regression covers both stale run-summary takeover and the existing fail-closed path.

evidence.command: The release-only recovery guard does not alter HTTP, tRPC, MCP, or shipped product contracts.

persistent_state.state_description: The release ledger schema, application database, local content format, and browser persistence are unchanged.

evidence.command: The recovery guard reads existing run metadata without changing persisted release or application state.
